text:
Jeong Sang-bin of St. Louis City SC has come out on top over Son Heung-min and his Los Angeles Football Club (LAFC) in their Korean derby in Major League Soccer (MLS) Cup Playoffs.
Jeong had a goal and an assist, while Son was held off the scoresheet as St. Louis defeated LAFC 3-2 in the opening match of their best-of-three Western Conference playoff series at Energizer Park in St. Louis on Monday (local time).
The second match will be at BMO Stadium in Los Angeles at 5:30 p.m. Saturday (local time), or 10:30 a.m. Sunday (Korean time).
St. Louis opened the scoring in the 35th minute on Daniel Edelman's goal, set up by a cutback from Rafael Navarro. Jeong, who had made the initial pass to Navarro, was credited with a secondary assist.
Jeong then doubled his side's lead in the 51st minute, as he fired a shot from the top of the box that went in off the left post.
LAFC responded with Sergi Palencia's goal in the 62nd minute, but St. Louis regained their two-goal advantage in the 78th minute as Simon Becher capitalized on an LAFC giveaway with a strike from just outside the box.
Denis Bouanga scored a penalty in the 85th minute for LAFC, but St. Louis held on for the one-goal victory on home turf.
The winner of this series will go on to meet either FC Dallas or Portland Timbers in the next round.
